official_requirement_text: 派訓單位主管對參訓學員的學習成效評估表。
serial_provenance: Current 03_157_CHECKBOX_BLUEPRINTS.md, row 097; do not confuse with DOCX ID 0090 or I17C behavior checkbox 090.
document_genre: Supervisor learning-outcome evaluation form with anchored rubric, completed synthetic case, calculations, decision, follow-up and evidence register.

unique_design.purpose: Assess whether a named training objective was learned and later applied, using source-located evidence and a supervisor decision.
unique_design.mandatory_distinction: Learning/satisfaction, observed behavior and aggregate organizational result must not be conflated. This document is the supervisor outcome-evaluation instrument; it does not replace I17C workplace-observation evidence or an I17D defect-rate table.
forms: Blank use-ready supervisor assessment with objective, baseline, assessment timing, evidence locator, anchored ratings, N/O handling, conclusion, hold/reject/continue decision and follow-up fields.
Fully completed SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC example with one individual score vector, denominator-safe cohort calculations and an explicit hold decision.

rating_rule.scale: 1-4, each level anchored to observable performance
rating_rule.not_observed: N/O is not zero and is excluded from assessed denominator; record reason and next observation opportunity.
rating_rule.decision_threshold: Mean >=3.0 and every designated critical item >=3 for PASS; any critical item below 3 is HOLD with targeted practice/reassessment; insufficient eligible observations is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

synthetic_case.course: 行政服務紀錄完整性與資料保護實作（假設示範，不代表協會實際課程）
synthetic_case.day_30_eligible_observations: 4/6 had an eligible task; 3/4 passed = 75.0%; 2/6 were N/O because no relevant task was assigned.
synthetic_case.individual_sample: SYN-P04 scores [3,4,3,3,2], mean 3.0/4; critical exception-escalation item=2, therefore HOLD despite meeting the mean threshold.
limitations: All persons, course, dates-as-relative-periods, scores and records are synthetic.
Small n; simulation and eligible-task results do not prove association-wide causal impact.
No shared case with DOCX 0088 or 0089 is asserted.
